rule_summary: Artifact generation and export functionality includes structured reports, data tables, and mind maps [1], [2].
Artifact generation is sensitive to the account-global output language setting [2], [5].
Mind maps have a unique storage dependency where they are backed by the notes system [2].
There is a complete parity gap for artifacts; no artifact tool module or resource currently exists in the MCP layer [3], [2], [4].
